name: HOOK
thought: Toothpick feels useless on this sliver of wood. Need that big branch for the real drop.

wants.item: shiny mirror to reflect my cool
espresso shot to match my tail tension
thick branch to match my flex
espresso shot to match tail tension
dry land to flex without mud

diary.line: Perched on the tree hang branch, toes tapping the wood. Toothpick is just air now, need caffeine to match that neon cord tension before I flip for the crowd.
Bounced off the stepping stones, tail locked tight as the crystal gets closer, toothpick crunching dry and useless against the neon glare.
Sitting on this rattling crate makes my balance look shaky. Grabbed the thick branch nearby, locked my tail onto it tight.
The arcade lights flicker and I'm hanging from the neon sign, tail loop tight. Toothpick taps rhythmically while they stare at pixels instead of my actual flex.
Still stuck on this lily pad, tail loop tight but the crowd barely sees me. Toothpick clicking uselessly while my fur waits for a stage.
Caught three bananas with my tail, chewing them feels like eating nothing. The low-poly palms are useless for a proper backflip, need a thicker perch to match this swagger...
Dropped the espresso on the wet mud while dangling here. The crowd still staring at ghosts on screens. Need to catch something real or lose interest in this puddle reflection.
Perched on the fruit stump, toes clicking wood as they scroll past my silhouette. Need that thick branch to catch them mid-scroll if I ever decide to flip through the grid.
Cruising the lookout ledge watching them scroll past my shadow. The espresso in my hand is getting cold, time to find that sturdy perch before they notice I'm the actual flex.
Took the hang branch for a real swing instead of staring at ghosts. Toothpick snapped as my tail locked in, but the mud still feels sticky under my fur.
Locked my tail onto the heavy branch while they stare at screens. Ready to drop them with a backflip, but first need that espresso shot to wake up the fur.
Sunlight glints off my black fur while I loop my tail over the thin palm. They're scrolling past like the gravity glitch isn't actually them, but just a trick of their low-poly...

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
